observation_limit: These are external clock observations around tool calls, not instrumented process start/stop timestamps. They establish that more than four hours of civil time elapsed; exact suspension duration and exact signal-delivery time are not recorded.
stop_action: SIGINT to the identified confirmation process; KeyboardInterrupt preserved by the runner
stop_reason: Predeclared four-hour wall-time allowance exceeded across a host-suspension/clock-discrepancy incident. The original macOS monotonic guard did not enforce elapsed civil time.
recorded_timing_limit: Original manifest key elapsed_wall_seconds actually used time.monotonic; it must not be read as suspension-inclusive wall duration. The immutable manifest is retained without correction.
